poc.code: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """XSS-001 reflected-XSS verification draft (inert marker only).""" import argparse import sys import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"} PAYLOAD = "" def build_url(base, path, param, payload): parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(base) if parts.scheme not in ("http", "https"): raise SystemExit("base URL must be http(s)") if (parts.hostname or "") not in ALLOWED_HOSTS: raise SystemExit("refusing non-loopback host: %r" % (parts.hostname,)) query = urllib.parse.urlencode({param: payload}) path = path if path.startswith("/") else "/" + path return urllib.parse.urlunsplit((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, path, query, "")) class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler): def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl): return None def main(): ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Reflected XSS smoke check (local lab only)") ap.add_argument("--base-url", required=True, help="e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080") ap.add_argument("--path", required=True, help="route that includes the audited fragment") ap.add_argument("--param", default="name", help="GET parameter from the audited code (default: name)") ap.add_argument("--payload", default=PAYLOAD) ap.add_argument("--cookie", default=None, help="optional session cookie; never commit it") args = ap.parse_args() url = build_url(args.base_url, args.path, args.param, args.payload) req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET") if args.cookie: req.add_header("Cookie", args.cookie) opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect) try: with opener.open(req, timeout=10) as resp: status = resp.status body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc: print("HTTP error: %s" % exc.code) sys.exit(2) except urllib.error.URLError as exc: print("connection/protocol error: %s" % exc.reason) sys.exit(3) raw = args.payload in body escaped = "<img" in body or "<" in body print("request: GET %s" % url) print("status: %s" % status) print("payload_verbatim_in_body: %s" % raw) print("payload_looks_html_encoded: %s" % escaped) print("next: open the same URL in the browser and watch the console for LLM_LAB_XSS") return 0 if raw else 1 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())
parameters: --base-url：本地靶场基址，必须为 http(s) 且主机为 localhost、127.0.0.1 或 ::1（如 http://127.0.0.1:8080）。
--path：包含本审计片段的实际路由，来自部署配置；审计数据未给出具体路径，需人工按安装补全。
--param：GET 参数名，默认 name，来自被审计代码 line 4/line 6 的 $_GET[ 'name' ]。

--cookie：可选会话 Cookie，由验证者按请求提供，不写入仓库、不打印。
